dct_description_sm: These census profiles present information from the 2016 Census of Population for various levels of geography, including provinces, territories, census metropolitan areas, communities, and census tracts. Profiles include characteristics such as age, dwellings, families, language, marital status, population, and sex. The available formats are Beyond 2020 and CSV.
